decisions.summary: Nucleated seating with no start_tree corridor, no access_exit, no reserve_field_corridor; exit_bearing kept only as a test of ground that refuses a margin with no way out; an empty AccessTree for bookkeeping; SeatRegion._reached flooded from a private anchor past the seat band on the way-out side, never reserved, painted or recorded
decisions.why: FR-001 removes both reservations; the bearing test is the spec's edge case and Decisions Recorded, and FR-008's parenthetical permits it as fixing nothing of the track's course. Checked in code: choose_track_out never reads _way_out_bearing or the anchor, so the bearing chooses no part of the lane. The anchor is FR-002's 'connected to the open country on the side the way out will leave'.

decisions.summary: Once the last house stands, inside stage_homesteads and before any farmstead is drawn, the track out's whole course is chosen once by choose_track_out (gateway, gateway_track/connector_track, connector_through) against the homesteads as seated and the wood seats, recorded as way_out_track; the ways are laid to it; stage_track draws the recorded track and chooses nothing; the row and dispersed forms, which record none, choose it in stage_track as before; no gate or first leg is decided apart from it
decisions.why: FR-008 and Amendment 2 verbatim ('collapsing the multiple decisions into a single decision regarding the lane'); FR-003's order (track out first, then the ways joined to it). The row/dispersed branch is still one decision per map and those forms never had the strip. way_out_gate is the first point of the recorded track, derived and not decided separately.

decisions.summary: The field path left to the web (settle_field, field_runs); an unreached field is fixed in the web's search, never by a reservation before the houses
decisions.why: FR-003 'then the field path as the web lays it' and FR-004's field reached; it forbids the reservation the GM asked removed.

decisions.summary: Every branch reading access_exit or the strip deleted (start_tree corridor, reserve_field_corridor, the strip gateway, on_the_strip, folds_on_the_strip, connector_through's strip fallback, web and joints strip exceptions, tree strip helpers, reserve_the_seating's strip, placement_stages' strip); the row and dispersed forms' path becomes the only path
decisions.why: Deleting the branches of a removed thing is the removal (FR-001); access_exit was written only on the nucleated form, so a row village's planned streets are untouched.

decisions.summary: Page 0081's drawing page already says houses first; claims citing the strip or field corridor rewritten with the code; owed checks run through claims-triage

A fourth, short component in the marsh outline's wave (WAVE_SHORT_FT, weighted by WAVE_WEIGHTS) so no shaped stretch runs straight past the visible-edge bar; one-shot measurement 160 ft to 85 ft over laid and short-ended strips, 40 seeds each
decisions.why: FR-007 and Amendment 1 ('Fix marsh ends first'); the bar is the existing guarantee test SC-006 names. The figures carry a one-shot label (date and method).
